A_weight_layout.exact_total_bytes_method: Sum of the 6 shard files' exact byte sizes as reported by the HF tree API's file listing at the pinned revision -- this is the most authoritative figure (real on-disk file sizes), not a parameter-count derivation.
A_weight_layout.index_json_vs_tree_sum_delta_note: model.safetensors.index.json's internal metadata.total_size field is a parameter-count-derived figure, not a re-measurement of actual file bytes -- it differs from the tree API's summed real file sizes by 28,592 bytes (per-shard safetensors header/padding overhead not counted in total_size). The tree-API sum (29,319,042,992 bytes) is treated as authoritative for 'exact bytes on disk'.
A_weight_layout.duplicate_format_note: No .bin PyTorch files or alternative single-file format present in the pinned-revision tree -- exactly one BF16 safetensors representation exists.
A_weight_layout.native_stored_dtype_source: config.json torch_dtype field at the pinned revision

hf_api_safetensors_expand_field.clarification: This HF API field ('total': 14659507200) is a PARAMETER COUNT (14,659,507,200 parameters), not a byte count. 14,659,507,200 params x 2 bytes/param (BF16) = 29,319,014,400 bytes -- matching the index.json total_size exactly, confirming that field is parameter-arithmetic-derived. Only the tree-API summed shard bytes (29,319,042,992) reflect actual on-disk file sizes including safetensors header/padding overhead.

B_tokenizer_and_chat_template.tokenizer_config_chat_template_format: Simple non-thinking ChatML-style template: <|im_start|>role<|im_sep|>content<|im_end|> (note the <|im_sep|> token, distinct from vanilla ChatML's plain newline separator). No reasoning/thinking tags -- this is the base phi-4 instruct release, distinct from the separate Phi-4-reasoning variant which is out of scope for this control.
B_tokenizer_and_chat_template.trust_remote_code_source: config.json auto_map field is null at the pinned revision -- no custom remote modeling class is declared, so this is a standard Phi3ForCausalLM architecture requiring no trust_remote_code flag.
